purpose: Each snapshot solvent's own EU hazard classification and REACH registration status.
rule: Only the solvent's own entries, found by the EC and Annex VI index numbers ECHA CHEM assigns to its CAS number; an Annex VI entry for another composition (a reaction mass, a mixture, '... containing >= 0.1 % butadiene') is left out. Harmonised hazard classes come from CLP Annex VI; the other classes from the lead REACH registrant's own classification of the substance where a registration exists: every section 2.1 record for the substance's own compositions, leaving out records for a special grade (an impurity at or above a threshold, a technical, commercial, raw or crude grade, a solution or a reaction mass), and within one hazard class the most severe code; else from the classification at least half of at least 10 notifying companies give. A majority 'not classified' means not classified. No national list is used; a solvent with no EU data is 'no EU data', never 'safe'.
